Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this ONE supplied own poster into one finished flat opaque 16:9 landscape poster. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Observed correction: the shirt torso and cream/ink pouch currently have only two similarly broad dark bars. Correct ONLY their bounded textile pattern to three unequal ink-dark bars with clearly unequal cream spacing. On the upper-right T-shirt torso, make exactly THREE complete dark transverse bands from top to bottom: narrow, broad, medium, widths in approximately 1 : 2 : 1.4 relation. Between band one and band two use a wider cream gap; between band two and band three use a narrower cream gap. All three bars remain within the continuous torso panel and above the lower hem, following its oblique cotton plane and natural folds. Keep the same vermilion asymmetric triangular reinforced corner and stitched hem intact.

On the lower-left cream/ink completed pouch, show the corresponding ordered THREE dark bars, same narrow/broad/medium proportion and same wide/narrow gap order, transformed into the pouch front. Truncate bars naturally at its sewn side edges, and retain that same red reinforced corner at the base. Both objects must visibly share this distinctive ordered material structure. Three bars must be clearly discernible on each at 720-wide display, not suggested as fine pinstripes. No fourth band or extra abstract stripe is added.

Protected relationships: preserve the current opposing-corner shirt and two finished pouches, the two separate adult palms supporting and offering the pouches inward, the plain terracotta second pouch, shallow photographic cotton light, functional zipper mouths, seams and hand contacts. Preserve the cobalt background, light middle interval, central dominant upright Korean title with English above and activity below, and exactly two factual islands in upper-left and lower-right. Keep all existing eleven Korean/English copy entries verbatim, exactly once each, with intact word spaces, numbers, colons, comma, centered middle dots and the en dash in the time. Keep their current legibility and horizontal single-line arrangements; no type replacement, added copy, logos, pseudo-print, QR, watermark, frame, panels or mockup. Retain the clear space around type and the energetic approachable adult daytime-event tone. Finish the corrected bars as real worn cotton dye on the existing knit surface with coherent folds and edges.
